Wrapping up

When do you split an agent?

Look for this

The agent drops requirements as its task grows, has more work than fits in its context, or does more than you can keep track of.

Tradeoffs

Costs can rise when the split adds work, but narrower tasks can run on cheaper models. Complexity moves from the agent into the system, which is easier to control but still needs design and monitoring.
